description: This Java source file defines the ImagesApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing images related to entities such as clients and staff within the Fineract platform. It includes methods for uploading, retrieving, updating, and deleting images, supporting both multipart form uploads and base64 data URLs.

classes.name: ImagesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing images associated with entities such as clients and staff in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: addNewClientImage
methods.description: Handles uploading a new image via multipart form data or base64 data URL for a specified entity and entity ID.

methods.name: retrieveImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image for a specified entity and entity ID, supporting resizing and different output formats.

methods.name: updateClientImage
methods.description: Updates an existing image for a specified entity and entity ID, supporting multipart form data and base64 data URL.

methods.name: deleteClientImage
methods.description: Deletes an image associated with a specified entity and entity ID.

methods.name: validateEntityTypeforImage
methods.description: Validates that the provided entity type is valid for image management.

methods.name: checkValidEntityType
methods.description: Checks if the given entity type string matches a valid EntityTypeForImages enum value.
